1.  UPSC  Completes  100  Years  
The  Union  Public  Service  Commission  (UPSC)  marked  its  Centenary  in  2026 .  
Key  facts  
●  UPSC  was  established  in  1926 .  ●  Its  centenary  celebrations  culminated  on  1  October  2026 .  ●  The  main  celebration  was  held  at  Bharat  Mandapam,  New  Delhi .  ●  Prime  Minister  Narendra  Modi  participated.  ●  A  commemorative  coin  and  stamp  were  released.  ●  A  book  titled  100  Landmark  Judgements  –  Shaping  the  Policies  of  UPSC  and  Public  Service  Commissions  in  India  was  also  released. Press  Information  Bureau 
Quiz  questions  
Q1.  In  which  year  was  UPSC  established?  
Answer:
 
1926
 
Q2.  In  which  year  did  UPSC  celebrate  its  centenary?  
Answer:
 
2026

5.  🛣  Tamil  Nadu  Gets  Barrierless  Multi-Lane  
Free-Flow
 
Tolling
 
This  is  especially  important  for  students  from  Tamil  Nadu.  
The  National  Highways  Authority  of  India  (NHAI)  rolled  out  Tamil  Nadu's  first  barrierless  Multi-Lane  Free  Flow  tolling  system  in  October  2026. Press  Information  Bureau 
What  is  Multi-Lane  Free  Flow?  
Traditional  toll  plazas  require  vehicles  to:  
slow  down  →  enter  lane  →  pay/scan  →  cross  barrier  
A  free-flow  system  is  designed  to  allow  vehicles  to  pass  through  without  conventional  toll  
barriers.

tolling
 
system?

Answer:  National  Highways  Authority  of  India  
Q3.  Which  state  got  this  first  system?  
Answer:  Tamil  Nadu

One  Nation,  One  Election  proposes  holding:

10.  🗳  DELIMITATION  
This  is  an  extremely  important  topic  for  2026.  
What  is  delimitation?  
Delimitation  =  redrawing  electoral  constituency  boundaries.  
It  is  done  to  reflect  changes  in  population  and  representation.  
2026  development  
The  government  introduced:  
●  Constitution  (131st  Amendment)  Bill,  2026  ●  Delimitation  Bill,  2026  ●  Union  Territories  Laws  (Amendment)  Bill,  2026  
These  were  introduced  in  the  Lok  Sabha  on  16  April  2026 . New  India  Samachar 
Important  point  
The  government  stated  that  the  proposed  changes  would  not  affect  elections  being  held  before  2029 . Press  Information  Bureau 
Why  is  delimitation  important?  
Because  it  can  affect:  
●  Number  of  seats  ●  Constituency  boundaries  ●  Representation
